description: Declarative classification rules for Suffolk County Council spending rows. Source: monthly CSV 'expenditure exceeding £250' published by SCC at /council-and-democracy/open-data-suffolk/.../expenditure-exceeding-250. Coverage Jan 2025 – Mar 2026 (15 months) on the live page; older years require FOI. Header columns: Organisation Name, Organisation Code, Directorate, Service Area, Sub-Service Area, Sub-description, Payment Date, Sub Amount, Inv Amount, Supplier Name. £250 threshold (lower than peers' £500). UTF-8 with BOM. ~37K rows/month → ~440K rows/year. Sample: 9.5% (3,523/37,205) of Mar 2026 rows are REDACTED PERSONAL DATA — Adult Social Care Direct Payments (Care Act 2014 s.31 DP, lawfully unnamed). Pension Fund is published as a separate file (suffolk_pension_csvs/) and ingested separately if at all.

rules.reason: 3,523 rows / month = 9.5% of feed. Suffolk publishes single canonical string 'REDACTED PERSONAL DATA' for ASC Direct Payment recipients (Care Act 2014 s.31). Uses the broadened cross-council regex for safety. Will not match REDACTIVE / REDACTION trade names.

match.supplier_regex: ^(SUFFOLK (COUNTY COUNCIL )?PENSION FUND|SUFFOLK COUNTY COUNCIL|VERTAS IPSWICH LTD|VERTAS GROUP LTD|VERTAS SUFFOLK LTD)$

rules.reason: SCC group entities. SUFFOLK COUNTY COUNCIL (54 rows / £43M) = self-payments / internal recharges. VERTAS IPSWICH LTD + VERTAS GROUP LTD (1,200 rows / £16.6M) = wholly-owned facilities-management subsidiary spun out by SCC in 2013 (now JV with Essex CC since 2020 — keep at internal_transfer because >50% ownership and entire trading footprint is council-commissioned). PENSION FUND defensive rule.

match.supplier_regex: ^(INLAND REVENUE|HM REVENUE (AND |& )?CUSTOMS|HMRC|NHS PENSIONS|UNITY SCHOOLS PARTNERSHIP|SUFFOLK ACADEMIES TRUST|EAST SUFFOLK COUNCIL|WEST SUFFOLK COUNCIL|IPSWICH BOROUGH COUNCIL|MID SUFFOLK DISTRICT COUNCIL|BABERGH DISTRICT COUNCIL|EAST SUFFOLK AND NORTH ESSEX NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|WEST SUFFOLK NHS FOUNDATION TRUST|NHS SUFFOLK AND NORTH EAST ESSEX ICB|NORFOLK AND SUFFOLK NHS FOUNDATION TRUST)$

rules.reason: Statutory passes. INLAND REVENUE (£66M, 112 txns) = PAYE / NI / pension contributions remitted to HMRC. UNITY SCHOOLS PARTNERSHIP (424 txns / £18.7M) + Suffolk Academies Trust = academy block grants (Education Act 2002 funding agreement, no procurement discretion). Suffolk districts (East/West Suffolk, Ipswich, Mid Suffolk, Babergh) get DFG (HGCR Act 1996) + concessionary travel + BCF s.75. NHS trusts + ICB get pooled-budget transfers (NHS Act 2006 s.75).
